cuts.ofreeRecent: her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a cup in both hands; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; a far-future orbital visitor centre with a miniature rotating planetarium dome and an empty curved demonstration dais — taking a break by pretending to host the planetarium show; a bus shelter on a quiet street — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake at chest height; a maintenance shed with a long workbench — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her
